info.name: Logging a multi-line message to the Plex Media Server log

items.docs: This endpoint will write multiple lines to the main Plex Media Server log in a single request. It takes a set of query strings as would normally sent to the above PUT endpoint as a linefeed-separated block of POST data. The parameters for each query string match as above.

info.name: Logging a single-line message to the Plex Media Server log

params.name: level
params.description:
An integer log level to write to the PMS log with.
  - 0: Error
  - 1: Warning
  - 2: Info
  - 3: Debug
  - 4: Verbose

params.name: message
params.description: The text of the message to write to the log.

params.name: source
params.description: A string indicating the source of the message.

items.docs:
This endpoint will write a single-line log message, including a level and source to the main Plex Media Server log.

Note: This endpoint responds to all HTTP verbs **except POST** but PUT is preferred

params.name: minutes
params.description: The number of minutes logging should be sent to Papertrail

items.docs:
This endpoint will enable all Plex Media Serverlogs to be sent to the Papertrail networked logging site for a period of time

Note: This endpoint responds to all HTTP verbs but POST is preferred
